name: Cron Decoder
description: Paste a crontab line and read it in plain English, with the next six fire times and a field-by-field breakdown. Understands ranges, lists, steps, month and weekday names and the @daily-style shortcuts, and it tells you when a schedule means something other than it looks like. Everything is computed inside the popup: no servers, no accounts, no permissions.

browser_action.default_title: Cron Decoder — Read any crontab line at a glance
